props.title: What Is Balinese Massage?

children: Balinese massage is a traditional treatment influenced by healing practices from Bali, Java, India, and China. The treatment combines acupressure, gentle stretching, skin rolling, and flowing strokes to ease tension and help you relax. Our therapists adapt the pressure and focus areas according to your comfort and preferences. For its history and techniques, read our guide

props.feature1Text: Combines acupressure, stretching, skin rolling, and rhythmic massage movements.
props.feature2Text: Suitable for both gentle relaxation and firmer muscle relief sessions.

props.title: What to Expect from a Balinese Massage
props.text: Your Balinese massage starts with a short chat about the pressure you like and any areas that need extra attention. Your therapist then works over the whole body with oil and long, flowing strokes. What to expect:

items.question: What is a Balinese massage?
items.answer: Balinese massage is a full-body massage with steady pressure, gentle stretching and aromatic oils, influenced by healing practices from Bali, Java, India and China. It combines acupressure, skin rolling and flowing strokes. At Spa Bali Moon you can have it at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: What should I wear during a Balinese massage?
items.answer: We give you a clean towel or spa wear before your Balinese massage at Spa Bali Moon. Only the area being massaged is uncovered, so you stay covered and comfortable throughout. Massage oil is used, and you can ask for lighter or firmer pressure at any time.

items.question: Is Balinese massage good after surfing or outdoor activities?
items.answer: Yes. Balinese massage is a popular choice after surfing, sightseeing, or other outdoor activities in Bali. Its strokes and stretches help tired muscles relax, and your therapist can give extra attention to the areas that feel tired.

items.question: How often should I get a Balinese massage?
items.answer: Once or twice during a holiday suits most visitors. Regular guests at Spa Bali Moon often book weekly or monthly to stay relaxed and keep muscle tension down.

items.question: What are the benefits of a Balinese massage?
items.answer: Balinese massage eases muscle tension and everyday stress, helps you relax and leaves your body feeling refreshed. Many guests find it especially welcome after a long flight or a busy day of travel; if your legs feel heavy after flying, a gentler [lymphatic drainage massage](/seminyak/lymphatic-drainage-massage/) is another choice.

items.question: How much does a Balinese massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A Balinese massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 159.000 for 1 hour, IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 330.000 for 2 hours per person. Packages with a manicure and pedicure, cream bath or facial start at IDR 375.000 per person. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Which massage is best if I've never had one before?
items.answer: Balinese massage is the treatment Spa Bali Moon recommends most often for first-time guests. It combines relaxation, gentle stretching and traditional massage techniques suitable for most people, and you can ask for lighter or firmer pressure at any point.

items.question: How long should a Balinese massage be?
items.answer: One hour covers the whole body and costs IDR 159.000 per person at Spa Bali Moon, which also suits guests with limited time. Choose 1.5 hours (IDR 239.000) or 2 hours (IDR 330.000) if you want more time on tense areas or a slower, more unhurried Balinese massage.

items.question: How is Balinese massage different from traditional or deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Balinese massage uses steady pressure, flowing strokes, gentle stretching and aromatic oils. Traditional massage at Spa Bali Moon is firmer, using kneading and focused pressure to release muscle tension, while deep tissue massage is a firm, slow massage that works deeper into tight muscles. For 1 hour they cost IDR 159.000, IDR 169.000 and IDR 269.000 per person.

items.question: Can couples have a Balinese massage side by side?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers a [couple Balinese massage](/seminyak/couple-spa/) for two guests side by side, each with their own therapist, in a private room at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel. It costs IDR 319.000 for two for 1 hour, IDR 479.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 659.000 for 2 hours.

items.question: Can I have a Balinese massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers the same Balinese massage as home service at your villa, hotel or private accommodation, for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area on top of the treatment price. Your therapist brings fresh linen, oils and everything the massage needs.

items.question: Can I book a Balinese massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my Balinese massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your Balinese massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
